description: Read one Base mainnet token contract's own metadata at a named block: its name, symbol, decimals, exact total supply, deployed bytecode size, and whether the address is an EIP-1167 or EIP-1967 proxy whose implementation should be read instead. Decimals is reported as a number, never inferred from the symbol, because it decides the scale of every amount the caller reads afterwards. Choose this when you must handle a token you did not issue: the decimals to scale every amount by, the symbol and name to report, the exact total supply, and whether the address is a proxy whose implementation you should read. Do not choose this for balances, prices, holders or transfers: it reads one token contract's own metadata on Base mainnet and nothing else. Use the address profile for balances and the payment verification for a transfer. Example requests: How many decimals does USDC have on Base? 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 | What is this token's symbol, name and total supply on Base? | Is this token address a proxy, and what is its total supply?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

block_number.description: Optional: the block height to read at. Default is the latest block, and the height used is always reported.

token_address.description: The 0x-prefixed 20-byte token contract address to read.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
